page_title: DAR 1-2 STU | Darmstadt v Stuttgart 17/02/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+8' The attendance is 17810.
90+7' Torsten Lieberknecht appears to have said too much and referee Tobias Welz comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.

90+5' 1 - 2 Aaron Seydel (Darmstadt) controls the ball on the edge of the box after a superb low pass by Oscar Vilhelmsson. He makes a yard for himself and fires a wonderful strike into the top right corner via the woodwork. 1:2!
90+2' 0 - 2 Mahmoud Dahoud (VfB Stuttgart) picks up a rebound, prepares for a shot and sends the ball home.

90+2' Good touch by Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart) as he latched on to an accurate pass before attempting to threaten the goalkeeper with his long-range shot. Unluckily for him, his attempt only rattles the left post.
90' We will have 8 min. of added time.
90' Julian Justvan (Darmstadt) receives a yellow card from the referee as expected.

88' What a poor attempt! Aaron Seydel (Darmstadt) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands.
88' Woo-Yeong Jeong (VfB Stuttgart) is found in space by a decent pass, and he immediately hits a rocket of a shot at goal that clips the outside of the left post.

87' Aaron Seydel (Darmstadt) connects with a cross on the edge of the box, controls the ball and pulls the trigger. Fabian Bredlow makes a beautiful save to deny his effort which would have ended in the bottom left corner.
86' It is time for a substitution. Fabian Schnellhardt (Darmstadt) is on for Marvin Mehlem.
86' A substitution has been made. Klaus Gjasula goes off and Oscar Vilhelmsson (Darmstadt) comes on.
81' Sebastian Hoeness is forced to make a change. Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) is unable to continue due to injury, Mahmoud Dahoud comes on.
81' The referee allows time for a substitution. Maximilian Mittelstadt will be replaced by Leonidas Stergiou (VfB Stuttgart).

81' What a chance that is! Sebastian Polter (Darmstadt) squanders a huge opportunity as he latches on to a perfect cross from the wing. He and produces a bullet header from around the penalty spot which goes well wide of the left post!
80' The injury to Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.
79' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) is having a really tough time right now. We are about to find out how serious his injury is.
78' A wild effort from Woo-Yeong Jeong (VfB Stuttgart) on the edge of the box flies well wide of the right post.
75' Darmstadt are ruled offside.

74' Aaron Seydel (Darmstadt) meets a delivery on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards the top of the net. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Fabian Bredlow produces an easy save.
74' It will be a substitution. Fabio Torsiello (Darmstadt) is ready to enter the pitch as Emir Karic walks off.
74' Here is a change. Luca Pfeiffer is going off and Torsten Lieberknecht gives the last tactical orders to Aaron Seydel (Darmstadt).
72' Fabian Nurnberger (Darmstadt) unleashes a shot from a mid-range free kick that crashes into the defensive wall. The opposition's goalkeeper set it up perfectly.
71' Substitution. Chris Fuhrich walks off the pitch and Woo-Yeong Jeong (VfB Stuttgart) comes on as a substitute.
71' Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) will have to be careful for the rest of the match as he is shown a yellow card.
70' Flag up against Sebastian Polter (Darmstadt). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
69' Although Alexander Brunst (Darmstadt) is just on the bench, Tobias Welz has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
67' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.
67' That's a clear yellow card. Christoph Zimmermann (Darmstadt) goes into the book.
65' Luca Pfeiffer (Darmstadt) was waiting for the ball on the penalty spot and produced a powerful volley towards the right side of the target, but the goalkeeper made an amazing save to deny him.
63' Substitution. Serhou Guirassy will be replaced by Enzo Millot (VfB Stuttgart).
63' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) attempts to find his teammate with a final pass from outside of the box, but one of the defenders clears the ball to safety.
62' Emir Karic (Darmstadt) sends a cross into the box, but Fabian Bredlow comes off his line to gather the ball.
61' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

59' Julian Justvan (Darmstadt) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike to the bottom left corner. Fabian Bredlow pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill.
57' Fabian Nurnberger (Darmstadt) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
57' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) is penalised for a foul. Tobias Welz had a clear view and blows his whistle.
54' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
49' Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) attempts to find one of his teammates with a cross from the resultant free kick, but he fails to hit the ball properly and sends it off the pitch.

48' Matthias Bader (Darmstadt) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement. Free kick. Stuttgart will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
47' The free kick is delivered by Angelo Stiller (VfB Stuttgart) but it's not one of his best and is easily cleared.
47' Tobias Welz blows his whistle after Emir Karic (Darmstadt) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. Stuttgart are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Jamie Leweling comes off for Josha Vagnoman (VfB Stuttgart).
46' Torsten Lieberknecht has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Fabian Nurnberger (Darmstadt) comes on the pitch for Christoph Klarer.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+26' The match has reached half-time.
45+24' This is a yellow card! Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
45+22' Pascal Stenzel (VfB Stuttgart) is awarded a second yellow by Tobias Welz and subsequently dismisses him with a red one.
45+21' The linesman raises his flag. Luca Pfeiffer (Darmstadt) is adjudged offside.
45+20' Deniz Undav (VfB Stuttgart) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
45+19' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart).
45+18' Julian Justvan (Darmstadt) receives a sweet pass inside the box, but his effort on goal is blocked by the defender.
45+14' Christoph Klarer (Darmstadt) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
45+13' Pascal Stenzel (VfB Stuttgart) makes a bad challenge on his opponent and is booked by the referee.
45+9' Klaus Gjasula (Darmstadt) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Tobias Welz has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
45+8' Darmstadt are seeing far more of the ball now.
45+5' Sebastian Polter (Darmstadt) strikes from the edge of the box, but hits it really poorly and sends the ball way over the bar.
45+4' Now Darmstadt have a corner.
45' There will be a minimum of 20 min. of added time.
45' Jamie Leweling (VfB Stuttgart) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
44' Julian Justvan (Darmstadt) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
43' Julian Justvan (Darmstadt) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

41' Luca Pfeiffer (Darmstadt) receives a lofted pass and is given time inside the box to unleash a shot goalwards. The ball is directed to the bottom left corner, but it lacks power and Fabian Bredlow pulls off a comfortable save to thwart the effort.
40' Julian Justvan (Darmstadt) whips in the resulting set piece but it's cleared.
38' Stuttgart hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
36' Everything seems to be alright after the game was interrupted, the referee blows his whistle and the match can continue.
25' Total attempts – 1:6.
24' The match will be interrupted for a while due to some disturbances.
17' Celebrations are cut short for Darmstadt as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was handball!
17' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was a handball in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Darmstadt players aren’t happy.
16' Goal! Marvin Mehlem (Darmstadt) picks up the ball from a rebound and from the edge of the box he unleashes a shot into the top left corner. 1:1.
14' 0 - 1 GOAL! Serhou Guirassy (VfB Stuttgart) scores with a header from close range after Waldemar Anton headed a pin-point lofted cross into his path. It's 0:1.
13' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) works the corner short.
10' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Stuttgart was in an offside position.
7' A long pass finds Atakan Karazor (VfB Stuttgart) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post.
5' Julian Justvan (Darmstadt) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
5' Julian Justvan (Darmstadt) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender. Darmstadt will take a corner kick.

2' Chris Fuhrich (VfB Stuttgart) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the right side of the goal, but Marcel Schuhen thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are out at last! Darmstadt will take the kick-off.
Tobias Welz will referee today's match.
Show lineups The starting lineups of both teams are already revealed and you can check them out in the details of this match.
